   **Bugs and stability.**
      9 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Nov 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Eazy Triple OG_, Nov 19, 2026, 1/5: "You’re getting 1-starred for this ongoing glitch. Have 30 seconds to enter snack calories before a break ends? Sorry; time to log in again because the app has decided to randomly log you out again for no apparent reason whatsoever! Soo tired of this issue. These are not CIA secrets; they are OREO calories!!😡"
            2. _Oksana Borovyk_, Nov 18, 2026, 1/5: "It was great and I even used the premium version… until the app completely changed its interface and is much more annoying to use now. I can’t scroll between days as easily, can’t see all the entries in one spot without having to click around, just overall annoying. The old interface was great. There was a workaround where you can change your location and that unlocks the old interface. Not anymore. The app is unusable. Very unfortunate"
            3. _Pramey96_, Nov 12, 2026, 1/5: "New update has ruined the app. Interface is both more complicated and provides less functionality at the same time. It is also very buggy, for example not allowing you to press controls at the bottom of the iPhone which makes some features unusable. The old app used to work so well. Bring it back!"
